title: Time bound for unary polynomial output
statement: For all natural numbers $C$ and $e$, the machine $	ext{polyUnaryTM}(C,e)$ computes, on every Boolean input $x$, the word consisting of $C(|x|+1)^e$ copies of $1$ within $(C+5e+4)(|x|+1)^e$ steps.
